How this is counted
  • A listen is a play that lasted at least half the song. Shorter plays are not in the data at all.
  • Live versions, remasters, radio and single edits, extended cuts, feat. and with tags, and Taylor's Versions count as the original song. The Versions tab breaks them out.
  • Remixes and acoustic versions stay separate songs. Podcasts and audiobooks are excluded.
  • Times are local: UTC-8 before August 1, 2021 and UTC-5 from then on, with no daylight saving. Years, months, days and hours all use this.
  • "Last 30 days" and the other rolling ranges count back from the most recent listen, not from today.
  • Hours are the time actually played. Album covers come from Spotify, artist photos from Deezer.
